info.name: Adobe Captivate Prime API (Learning Manager) Account Skills API

params.name: page[offset]
params.description: The offset for pagination (number of records to skip)

params.name: page[limit]
params.description: Maximum number of records to return per page (max 10)

params.name: filter.name
params.description: Filter skills by name (partial match supported)

params.name: include
params.description: Comma-separated list of related resources to include. Valid values: skillLevels, learningObjects

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of skills defined in the account. Skills represent competencies that learners develop by completing learning objects.

params.name: skillId
params.description: The unique identifier of the skill

params.name: include
params.description: Comma-separated list of related resources to include

items.docs: Retrieves a single skill by its ID with its levels and associations.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user

params.name: page[offset]
params.description: The offset for pagination (number of records to skip)

params.name: page[limit]
params.description: Maximum number of records to return per page (max 10)

params.name: include
params.description: Comma-separated list of related resources. Valid values: skill, skillLevel

items.docs: Retrieves skills acquired by a specific user, including the skill level achieved and points earned toward each skill.
